title: civic tables
description: Generated by dryv pack mzizi.table-schemas from the contracts; do not edit. Its code is sys.sch.<group>; each table's x-code is sys.tbl.<group>.<table> (underscores written as dashes). Each $defs entry is one table: properties are the stored columns, each with an x-role (key, data, link or system); x-seed is the shape of a seed file row (natural key, data, and links written as the target's code, never ids or system fields). A link names its target table by contract id (x-id) and its seed alias in x-link.
